messages: I wonder how #p407#'s doing with the flying balloon... Maybe I should go check up on him in #m10003000#.

Icarus's flying balloon didn't work out, but his quest for flight continues. This time, he wants to deviate from a scientific approach and opt for a magical one. He asked me to go see his best friend, #b#p309##k, in #m10002000#, the town of fairies. Apparently, #p309# knows how to make #b#t4031079##k... I'll need to go see him in #m10002000#, for #p407#'s sake.
#p309# in #m10002000# dislikes humans so much that he wouldn't even listen to what I had to say.
name: In search of Wing the Fairy
